english.quote: Duolingo English Test (DET) : A minimum score of 120 is required TOEFL and TOEFL iBT Home Edition : TOEFL exams taken after January 21, 2026: A minimum TOEFL score of 4.5 on the internet-based TOEFL (code #2660) TOEFL exams taken before January 21, 2026: A minimum TOEFL score of 80 on the internet-based TOEFL (code #2660) Penn State does not accept TOEFL MyBestTM Scores IELTS : A minimum IELTS score of 6.5 on the academic test
english.notes: University-wide requirement for first-year international students whose native language is not English. DET 120; TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before 21 January 2026) or 4.5 (after); IELTS Academic 6.5; no per-section minimum published. Scores less than two years old. SAT EBRW 570 / ACT English 24 also accepted.
